metadata.summary: The Tabula Sapiens is a molecular atlas integrating single-cell transcriptomic data from 483,152 cells across 24 tissues and 15 donors, using a unified processing pipeline. It provides cell-type annotations spanning many human organs and serves as a reference for tissue mapping, cell-type identification, and cross-tissue comparative studies.
metadata.purpose: To serve as a reference for tissue mapping, cell-type identification, and cross-tissue comparative studies.

papers.title: The Tabula Sapiens: A molecular atlas of diverse cell types across the human body

ethics.privacy_measures: De-identified donor data; no protected health information retained.

known_limitations: Limited to 15 healthy adult donors; lacks pediatric, geriatric, and diseased cohorts.
No representation of underrepresented racial/ethnic groups.
Tissue sampling bias: some tissues overrepresented (e.g., blood, lung), others scarce (e.g., esophagus, adrenal).
Single-cell RNA-seq captures only transcriptome; no protein, epigenetic, or spatial context.
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Data processed through unified bioinformatic pipeline (quality control, normalization, integration); no synthetic data generation reported.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Not representative of global population diversity; limited to healthy adults from North American institutions.
bias_and_limitations.long_tail_classes: Some rare cell types (e.g., thymic epithelial subtypes) have low cell counts (<100).
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Findings generalizable to healthy adult human tissues but not to disease states, developmental stages, or underrepresented populations.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: Gender-balanced; age centered at ~51 years; no ethnic/racial subgroup coverage reported.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Some tissues had low cell yield or failed QC; missing data per donor/tissue not quantified in abstract/description.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Donors selected to represent diverse tissues and balanced gender; age range covered (mean 51 years).
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Single-cell RNA-seq performed on 24 tissues from 15 healthy adult donors; no explicit stratified or random sampling rationale stated beyond donor/tissue diversity.
data_origin.aggregation_multisource: Data aggregated across multiple institutions using a unified processing pipeline.

population.missing_groups: Pediatric, geriatric (>75), pregnant, and underrepresented ethnic/racial groups not included; no explicit reporting of ethnicity.

annotation.annotation_method: Cell-type annotations assigned by expert curators using marker genes and cross-tissue consistency.
annotation.labeling_provenance: Manually curated cell-type labels based on gene expression profiles and literature-supported markers.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Disease diagnosis, clinical decision support, or therapeutic prediction.
